headline: Lincoln take an unbeaten season into Friday
dek: Lincoln beat Roosevelt at home on Sunday for their sixteenth win, and four draws remain the only matches they have not won. Maryville drew at Saginaw Valley State the same day. Both are at home on Friday, Lincoln against Findlay and Maryville against Fort Hays State.
displaced_by: The dek's trip to Saginaw Valley State 'today' is now past; Lincoln's win over Roosevelt carries their unbeaten season into Friday's home match with Findlay.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Southwest Baptist have scored forty-five goals, more than either Lincoln or Drury near the top, but they have conceded thirty-six and lost seven times; the leaders have built their place at the other end of the pitch.

wire.line: Lincoln are the only programme in the conference still without a defeat this season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches past their date carry no result, and both are Drury's, one at home and one away, both from August.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Drury have lost five times this season: at home to Oklahoma Christian in August, away at Missouri S&T in September, at home to Lincoln and to Missouri-St. Louis in October, and at home to Maryville in November.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Jonathan Nemorden, a freshman, has thirteen of Lincoln's forty-four goals, from seventy-three shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Jacob Panagos, a midfielder, has fifteen of Truman's twenty-eight goals, from fifty-seven shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Noah Nymark-Pedersen has made seventy-nine saves for Upper Iowa and conceded thirty-five, a save percentage of .693.

last_match.line: Maryville have not lost since Lincoln beat them in October.

next_match.line: Lincoln have won every match they have played at home this season.
